title: Calendar
description: One month, standing on its own: a grid of real day buttons with today marked and a selection you can move.
usage: The Date Picker’s other half, unboxed — for booking pages, availability and anywhere the month itself is the interface. It renders one month and reports the pick; ranges, min/max and disabled days are your layer on top of its day buttons.
a11y: Days are buttons with full date labels ("November 14, 2026"), today carries aria-current, and the month title is a live heading the arrows update. Arrow-key grid navigation is the app’s layer; the tab stop per day is native.
